definitions.description_fields: Positional, unchanged denominators: 6 synthetic / 5 complete-private items; raw and cleaned reported separately.
definitions.pairs: One-to-one E7 >=0.85 description plus amount equality; field-only versus additional line-derived recovery. Private amount labels are atoms, not printed literals.
definitions.blank_synthetic_amounts: Two of six item labels are known-blank absence checks, not positive amount recovery.
definitions.taxonomy: First four counts partition expected descriptions; summary rows (TOTAL/SUBTOTAL prefix after cleanup) are extra predictions, not part of that partition. Matched means raw+cleaned E7; whole-line means cleaned E7 only with prefix/suffix removal. Unmatched non-summary predictions count as below-threshold description_misread up to remaining labels, then item_missing; this heuristic does not establish optical-error causality.
definitions.preservation: No raw text, model fields, thresholds, annotations, inference settings or historical timing/RSS changed. No model runs; historical records retained.
